about: Great Ones are Fabled (difficulty 10) trophy males with unique 'Fabled' furs and atypical TruRACS antlers/horns/tusks, scoring far beyond normal diamond thresholds. 14 species have one as of Patch 9.3 (Sept 2026). They are not announced per reserve; community consensus is that one can spawn on any reserve where the species lives, except where noted.

spawnMechanics.summary: Not officially documented. Great Ones are Fabled (level 10) males that appear as an extremely rare respawn when animals of that species are harvested on a reserve where the species lives. The 'grind' is to harvest very large numbers of the species' males (usually the highest-level males you see) on one reserve, often with herd management (keep a herd stacked with high-level males, avoid filling low-level slots). Player reports range from roughly 600 to 8,000+ kills per Great One; others report pure luck. The developers have said that a population reset does not affect Great One progress, which implies hidden per-species progress is tracked, but no kill count, trophy-rating threshold or spawn percentage has been published.
officialStatements: Population reset does not affect Great One progress (developer update quoted on Steam forums).
Great Ones are rated '10 - Fabled' regardless of the species' normal max level.
Update 1.73 (Mar 2023): Moose Great One now spawns with only Great One fur types.
communityTheories: Herd management: keep a herd full of high-level males and harvest the top ones so replacements are more likely high-level/Great One.
Harvest many males quickly from a tent, using sleep/time skips to refresh need zones.
Reported grinds: ~600 to ~8,000+ male kills; some report ~2,000 (whitetail) and ~3,500 (red deer).
spawnMechanics.notes: No official source describing a 'rampage' or fixed 'Great One spawn' kill-count/trophy-rating rule was found in patch notes 8.3-9.3 or official pages; kill counts above are player reports only. Treat any fixed number (e.g. '50 diamonds') as unverified.
